lines.en: Chika and I spend the night eating junk food and asking each other questions about things we'd like to know about one another.
lines.zh: 我和 Chika 晚上吃着垃圾食品，互相问对方想了解的事。

lines.en: She has a lot more questions than I do.
Real questions. Big ones...like 'What did you want to be when you grew up' or 'Do you ever want to get married?'
lines.zh: 真正的问题。很重大的那种……比如「你长大以后想做什么」，或者「你有想过结婚吗？」

lines.en: I have a hard time finding answers to all of them, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，这些问题我大多都答不上来。

lines.en: But even when that happens, it doesn't faze her one bit.
lines.zh: 但就算我答不上来，她也完全不在意。

lines.en: In between the barrage of questions, she wastes no time in reaching her feet out underneath the table and playfully poking and kicking me with them.
lines.zh: 在一连串问题之间，她还不忘从桌子底下伸脚过来，玩闹地戳我、踢我。

lines.en: She smiles the entire night. Even when nothing is happening.
lines.zh: 她整晚都在笑。就算什么都没发生，她也在笑。

lines.en: I wish I could do that.
I have a hard enough time smiling even when good things happen.
lines.zh: 就算碰上好事，我要笑出来都很费劲。

lines.en: If I was any good at smiling, I'd smile back at her.
lines.zh: 如果我真会笑，我会回她一个笑。

lines.en: But, being the person I am, I sit back and let her continue to play one-sided footsie with me as I finish off the last of the french fries on the table.
lines.zh: 但我就是这样的人，于是我靠回椅背，任由她继续一个人玩这种桌下踢脚的游戏，自己把桌上最后几根薯条吃完。

lines.en: Eventually, Chika moves to my side and rests her head on my shoulder.
lines.zh: 后来 Chika 挪到我身边，把头靠在我肩上。

lines.en: She tells me about her dreams. How {i}she{/i} wants to get married.
lines.zh: 她跟我讲她的梦想。讲{i}她{/i}想结婚。

lines.en: And how some day, in the distant future, she'd like to eat junk food and play question-games with someone who will look only at her.
lines.zh: 讲在遥远的将来某一天，她想和某个只看着她的人一起吃垃圾食品、玩问答游戏。
